name: snz-novel-devtools
description: 개발·테스트 전용 도구 의존성 — 게임 런타임 의존성은 0 (game/ 은 정적 파일만)

scripts.build:ko: python3 tools/parse_snz.py manuscript/SNZ_KO_Part1.md manuscript/SNZ_KO_Part2.md manuscript/SNZ_KO_Part3.md manuscript/SNZ_KO_Part4.md manuscript/SNZ_KO_Part5.md -o game/script.js -a tools/annotations/base.json -a tools/annotations/ko.json
scripts.build:en: python3 tools/parse_snz.py manuscript/SNZ_EN_Part1.md manuscript/SNZ_EN_Part2.md manuscript/SNZ_EN_Part3.md manuscript/SNZ_EN_Part4.md manuscript/SNZ_EN_Part5.md -o game/script.en.js -a tools/annotations/base.json -a tools/annotations/en.json
scripts.build:jp: python3 tools/parse_snz.py manuscript/SNZ_JP_Part1.md manuscript/SNZ_JP_Part2.md manuscript/SNZ_JP_Part3.md manuscript/SNZ_JP_Part4.md manuscript/SNZ_JP_Part5.md -o game/script.jp.js -a tools/annotations/base.json -a tools/annotations/jp.json
scripts.build: npm run build:ko && npm run build:en && npm run build:jp
